title: Warranty and support | VOOL
description: VOOL chargers have a 5-year warranty. What happens when something stops working, and how to reach support.

sections.title: Five years of warranty, and people who answer
sections.lead: VOOL chargers are built in Estonia and carry a 5-year warranty. Most problems are solved remotely, without a site visit.

items.title: Contact support
items.text: Write to us through the Help Center or at info@vool.com, or ask your installer.

items.title: We look at the device remotely
items.text: Connected chargers and LMCs send diagnostics, so we usually see the cause without a visit.

items.title: Fixed by update or setting
items.text: Many issues are solved with a software update or a configuration change.

items.title: Replacement part if needed
items.text: The charger is modular. A faulty charge controller is swapped in minutes and the casing and cabling stay.

items.title: 5-year warranty
items.text: On VOOL chargers, from the sale to the end customer.

items.title: Software updates
items.text: New features and fixes arrive over the air.

items.title: Remote diagnostics
items.text: For connected devices, at no extra cost.

items.title: Help Center
items.text: Installation guides, manuals and answers to common questions.

items.title: Support for installers
items.text: Installers keep remote access to the sites they set up.
